Select canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, enzyme_name. Source metabolism, compound_records, compound_structures. Join metabolism.substrate_record_id = compound_records.record_id and compound_records.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Filter enzyme_name = 'CYP2A6'. Sort by canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, enzyme_name. Limit 200.
